paper_title: Can 1B LLM Surpass 405B LLM Rethinking Compute-Optimal Test-Time   Scaling
caption: Comparison between the performance of smaller LLMs compute-optimal TTS and that of larger LLMs CoT on MATH-500 and AIME24. (a) & (d) Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct surpasses Llama-3.1-405B-Instruct and GPT-4o on MATH-500 and AIME24; (b) & (e) DeepSeek-R1-Distill-1.5B outperforms o1-preview on MATH-500 and AIME24, and surpasses o1-mini on MATH-500; (c) & (f) DeepSeek-R1-Distill-7B beats o1 on MATH-500 and AIME24, and exceeds DeepSeek-R1 on AIME24.

annotations.annotation: The bar chart presents performance comparisons of different models across two datasets, MATH-500 and AIME24. The horizontal axis shows categories labeled with model identifiers and configurations, such as "3B", "unk", "405B", "1.5B", "7B" and "671B", with additional differentiations like "(a)", "(b)", "(c)" for MATH-500 and "(d)", "(e)", "(f)" for AIME24. The vertical axis, labeled with percentages, has a linear scale ranging from 65 to 100 with tick marks at intervals of 5 units for MATH-500 charts, and range 0 to 90 for AIME24 charts with tick every 10 units. For MATH-500, chart (a) displays bars for three models: "Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct" (blue with stripes, approx. 78.2%), "GPT-4o" (purple, 74.6%), and "Llama-3.1-405B-Instruct" (green, 71.4%). In chart (b), bars represent "DeepSeek-R1-Distill-1.5B" (red with stripes, 91.6%), o1-mini (pink, 90.0%), and o1-preview (brown, 85.5%). Chart (c) features "DeepSeek-R1" (yellow, 97.3%), "DeepSeek-R1-Distill-7B" (orange with stripes, 95.2%), and "o1-preview" (grey, 94.8%). For AIME24, chart (d) shows "Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct" (blue, 30.0%), "Llama-3.1-405B-Instruct" (green, 23.3%), and "GPT-4o" (violet, 9.3%). Chart (e) includes "o1-mini" (pink, 63.6%) and "DeepSeek-R1-Distill-1.5B" (red with stripes, 63.3%), followed by "o1-preview" (brown, 44.6%). Finally, chart (f) presents "DeepSeek-R1-Distill-7B" (orange with stripes, 83.3%), "DeepSeek-R1" (yellow, 79.8%), and "o1-preview" (grey, 79.2%). The bars are sorted neither alphabetically nor by value and feature different colors and patterns to denote different models, with no additional visual emphasis or annotations. A legend is given in top describing all the models and bar.
